+    for r in range(h):
+        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
+            c = grid[r][0]
+            if all(all(v == c for v in row) for row in grid[r:r+1]):
+                if r and r < h - 1:
+                    a, b = grid[:r], grid[r+1:]
+                    if len(a) == len(b):
+                        # The paired-panel rule is being inferred from examples.
+                        pass
+    # Vertical separator
+    for j in range(w):
+        if all(row[j] == grid[0][j] for row in grid) and all(grid[i][j] == grid[0][j] for i in range(h)):
+            if j and j < w - 1:
+                left = [row[:j] for row in grid]
+                right = [row[j+1:] for row in grid]
+                if len(left[0]) == len(right[0]):
+                    return [[3 if left[i][k] == 7 and right[i][k] == 7 else 9
+                             for k in range(j)] for i in range(h)]
+    return grid
